arena_context_desc: static close-up underwater camera view of a dark volcanic hydrothermal chimney on the deep ocean floor, high contrast realistic documentary footage
static_hold_desc: dormant dark volcanic rock chimney in cold still deep blue ocean water without plumes
negative_desc: blurry, distorted, neon blob, cartoon, flat circles, text, watermark, human, diver, surface sky, camera shake

e0_plume.essence_desc: a roaring jet of superheated black-and-amber mineral smoke erupting from the volcanic chimney
e0_plume.action_desc: pumps billowy hot mineral-rich clouds and glowing orange heat shimmer into the freezing dark water

e0_flare.essence_desc: blazing orange lava cracks along the volcanic chimney rim
e0_flare.action_desc: surge with intense golden thermal waves and rising sparkling gas bubbles

e0_cold.essence_desc: a cold unlit dark basalt chimney with zero smoke
e0_cold.action_desc: stands completely still in freezing pitch-black abyssal water

e1_bare.essence_desc: clean dark wet basalt rock around the chimney opening
e1_bare.action_desc: absorbs the first warm mineral wisps from the vent

e1_bloom.essence_desc: lush glowing ivory-white and golden chemosynthetic bacterial mats and coral fans
e1_bloom.action_desc: bloom densely along the boundary of the hot dark plume

e1_crust.essence_desc: an overgrown thick calcified white mineral dome
e1_crust.action_desc: seals and chokes the chimney mouth, trapping the dark smoke beneath

e2_sparse.essence_desc: a few retracted dark-red tube worms at the base of the rock
e2_sparse.action_desc: wait quietly in the cold water shadow

e2_feast.essence_desc: a vibrant forest of bright crimson-plumed giant tube worms and white vent crabs
e2_feast.action_desc: swarm over the white mineral crust, grazing and cracking the dome open

e2_detritus.essence_desc: a dense swirling cloud of brown organic flakes and broken shells
e2_detritus.action_desc: drifts heavily across the crowded tube worm colony, clouding the water

e3_still.essence_desc: calm deep indigo ocean water surrounding the thermal boundary
e3_still.action_desc: holds a sharp temperature interface around the chimney

e3_flush.essence_desc: a sweeping cold sapphire-blue deep-ocean current
e3_flush.action_desc: washes away the murky brown organic cloud and clears the dark basalt rock

e3_freeze.essence_desc: crystal-clear icy blue abyssal water with settling silver mineral dust
e3_freeze.action_desc: exposes the clean volcanic chimney rim for a new cycle
